findings.summary: In SevenZipExtractor.extract, an empty targets list (all entries blocked or empty archive) may be treated by py7zr as no filter, extracting everything including path-traversal entries and defeating the fix.
archive.list() is called before extract(), and py7zr readers may be consumed or reset by earlier reads, so extract() may not work afterwards; this needs checking.
RarExtractor.safemembers/badlink unpacks info.file_redir, which is None for RAR3 symlinks, raising TypeError and failing extraction instead of skipping the entry.

badpath in the zip, rar and 7z extractors uses startswith(base) without a trailing separator, so sibling directories like /out/data_evil pass the check; the weakness is copied from the tar code into three more places.
The rar badlink validates the link target against the link's own directory instead of the extraction root, wrongly blocking harmless links such as ../sibling.
The 7z badlink is dead code because its only call site is commented out.
